headline: MarkTechPost reports that a peer review system from AI research company Sakana AI catches 73 percent of core-claim errors in research papers.
score_reason: Pool 5 lowered by 1: unverified, with the 73 percent figure coming from one outlet and no detail of the test available to us.
importance_line: Researchers and journal editors could one day get automated help spotting flawed claims in papers, but the 73 percent figure comes from a single outlet and has not been independently checked.
summary: MarkTechPost reports that Sakana AI, an AI research company, has a peer review system built on large language models that catches 73 percent of core-claim errors.
notes: Headline only: MarkTechPost returned 403 and no other outlet or Sakana AI page carried the story. URL given without the '?amp=1' suffix of the pool link.
